text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru drags me off by the
hand one
day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today we're going mountain
climbing. I
can't move mountains, but I
can sure move these
legs!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well you see, I heard something through
the
grapevine.
choice_data_list_en: Mountain climbing? Why all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you dial a certain phone number from
a
mystical spot, you can earn yourself
some good
luck... allegedly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, my plan is to scale this famous
spiritual
mountain and call that number!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's get to it! Neither rocks nor roots
are going
to stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head up the mountain, though it
turns out it's
not rocks or roots that we
have to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha! So you dare to show your
face! You will
not leave this place alive!

text_block_list.name: Lingering Spirit
text_block_list.text: Save meee... Please, save meee...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring the horrifying wailing, we trek
onward.
This certainly is a spiritual
mountain... in the sense
that it seems to
be full of spirits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're looking pretty pale, Trainer.
Running low
on oxygen?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't hear what? Oh, the birds? They
sound
kinda cute, huh? Chirp chirp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Spirits? Maybe... Maybe not. I can't
really tell...
choice_data_list_en: Do you not have a sixth sense or something?
Don't you have a sixth sense?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No use sweating the details though! Just
go with
the flow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As crazy for all things spiritual as she is,
it doesn't
look like she has even a hint of
a sixth sense.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew. All right, I guess this spot will do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's not waste any time. Now, where's
that lucky
number?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-my goodness! Just as I was getting
ready to
dial, my phone started ringing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What if this call is coming from
the lucky
number?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm, maybe it's best to pick up? We are
on a
lucky mountain, after all. We can't
get any
unlucky calls here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as optimistic, seeing what's been
lurking
up here. Time to make a
decision.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Hehe, I guess the owner of this
lucky
number just couldn't resist giving
me a ring.
choice_data_list_en: Why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hi, is this Luck E. Pearson speaking?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, this is Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Taiki... My phone shows this
as an
unknown number. Are you using a
pay phone or
something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You see, I was just about to call this
number that
brings you happiness.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A number that brings you happiness?
The heck is
that? Wait...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You sure you ain't got your boots on
backwards?
'Cause I've only heard of
numbers that'll curse ya
if ya call 'em.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Cursed numbers... Really? Wait... Could
it be that
I heard wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: T-Taiki, I-I'm gonna hang up now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer... This can't be...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeyikes! I don't want to be cursed! Save
meee!
choice_data_list_en: Looks like we made a mistake.
Looks like I made a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru hurtles down the
mountain at
a pace that would leave a
marathon runner pale
and wheezy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, you two. Where were you guys?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? I told you before
when we
were talking on the phone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Anyway, thanks for the heads-up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't told me about that cursed
number
thing, I would've been in a real
pickle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What heads-up? What're you talking
about? We
didn't talk on the phone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know what I'm talking about, silly!
You called
me earlier... on a pay...
phone...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But why would you do that when you've
got your
own phone right... there? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just who was it that called? Whoever it
was, all
that running around on the
mountain seems to
have done Fukukitaru
some good.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But, why? I don't see any reason not to
answer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait! That sound...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hey, my screen's cracked!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That can't be a good sign... I'm sensing
that
something bad is about to happen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-wh-what if this is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her about all the sinister things I
saw on the
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugwah! I-I had no idea! Eek, somebody
heeelp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru books it down the
mountain
as fast as she can.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to this. I actually talked it
over with
Taiki afterwards...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, that phone number wasn't
lucky at
all. It was cursed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Looks like it.
choice_data_list: スマホが身代わりになってくれた？
choice_data_list_en: Did your phone take the hit for you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, thank you, my sweet phone. May
you rest
in perfect peace. And also...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
May your repairs go quickly. It's really

inconvenient without you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's going to pretend her phone
isn't
cursed and keep using it.
